answer: A workable design: score token-distribution divergence against the identity's own answer history. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its zenith recurs, its harbor survives audit, and a pigment from an unlinked peer confirms it.
